name: cro-kit
description: Conversion rate optimization (CRO) for your own pages, forms, checkouts and A/B tests. Says what to fix first on a landing, pricing or signup page, separating clear fixes from questions that need research, and judges real-user speed and goal tracking when you supply them. Reviews a form, signup or checkout field by field and checks the order step against EU and US checkout rules. Finds where a funnel loses people and whether a traffic-mix shift explains a drop. Sizes an A/B test in visitors per arm and weeks at your traffic. Reads a finished or running A/B test: figures that disagree, an uneven split, early stopping, the lift with its p-value as a number and an interval, then ship, hold or keep running. Works on page text and aggregate counts; it does not write marketing copy or build deceptive variants.

interface.shortDescription: Page checks and A/B test math
interface.longDescription: Five skills for conversion rate optimization (CRO) on your own site. Landing page audit reads one landing, pricing, product, demo or signup page literally and says what to fix first: an ad's promise the page does not keep, the main action out of reach on phones, competing equal actions, missing price or next-step information, real-user speed when you supply it (75th-percentile LCP, INP, CLS), tap targets and reflow, and whether the goal is counted once and matches the back end. Clear fixes are kept apart from questions that need research, and each fix says how to verify it. Checkout audit goes through a lead or demo form, signup or checkout field by field (keep, cut, optional or ask later), checks labels, errors, confirmation, login and accessibility, and checks the order step against dated EU and US consumer rules: order-button wording, total price before the button, pre-selected extras, payment surcharges, auto-renewal consent and marketing consent. Funnel analysis checks that your step counts agree, computes each step rate, separates a traffic-mix shift from a real change and sizes the stakes against a target or reference you name. A/B test sample size gives visitors per arm, calendar weeks, power at your worthwhile lift and the smallest lift a deadline can detect. A/B test verdict recomputes from your counts, checks the traffic split against the plan, explains what peeking and early stopping do to the result and reads a tool's 'chance to beat control', then answers ship, hold or keep running. Works on page text and aggregate counts; no benchmarks as targets, no predicted lifts, no deceptive variants; not legal advice.
defaultPrompt: A/B test on our pricing page: A 300/10,000 signups, B 345/10,150. 50/50 split, 14 days. Can we ship B?
Signup rate is 3% on 6,000 visitors a week. How long must an A/B test run to detect a 10% relative lift?
Audit our checkout: 4 steps, account required, 16 fields, shipping cost shown only at the last step. We sell to EU and US.
